selection: Follow-up convenience cohort fixed from commit subjects and file statistics before detector outcomes: three whole-construct transfers (IPP histogram, IPP color, OpenVX FAST), one in-place IPP warp revision. All changed C/C++ source/header paths, including new files. No replacement after outcomes. Selected to examine larger eligible constructs after the prior expression-statement limitations; not random, held out, or population accuracy evidence.

source_review.method: Reviewed source diffs and source-only srcML inventories before srcDiff/srcMove execution. Nine named non-overlapping whole constructs: seven edited cross-file transfers and two whole-function edits in place. Source expectations independent of matching thresholds and extraction. Competing semantic roles noted explicitly; any detector-discovered extra edge is a separate post-outcome review, not an addition to this denominator.

targets.source_reason: Distinct histogram worker, TLS allocation, histogram initialization and atomic accumulation transfer together; only instrumentation call removed. Old class removed, destination added; not the TLS-only class or public HAL wrapper.
